qr.title: Connect with QR Code
qr.description: Scan the QR code in the NexusViewPanel app with your phone's camera, then paste the entire text string (it starts with 'http://...') into the field below.

manual.title: Connect Manually
manual.description: Enter the connection details for your NexusViewPanel device.

name.title: Name Your Device
name.description: Set a friendly name and the polling intervals for this device.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Please check the host, port, and token. Is the device online?
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please check your API Token.
error.invalid_qr: Invalid string format. It should look like 'http://device_ip:port/swagger?api_token=token'

select_tab.name: Select Tab
select_tab.description: Switch the active tab on the NexusViewPanel device.

tab_index.name: Tab Index
tab_index.description: The zero-based index of the tab to select.

reload_tab.name: Reload Tab
reload_tab.description: Force a hard reload of a specific tab.

tab_index.name: Tab Index
tab_index.description: The zero-based index of the tab to reload.

float_tab.name: Float Tab
float_tab.description: Open a specific tab in the floating window.

tab_index.name: Tab Index
tab_index.description: The zero-based index of the tab to open in the floating view.

reload_all_tabs.name: Reload All Tabs
reload_all_tabs.description: Force a reload of all configured tabs.

update_webview_tab.name: Update WebView Tab
update_webview_tab.description: Update the properties of an existing WebView tab.

tab_index.name: Tab Index
tab_index.description: The zero-based index of the WebView tab to update.

url.name: URL
url.description: New URL for the WebView to load.

update_rtsp_tab.name: Update RTSP Tab
update_rtsp_tab.description: Update the properties of an existing RTSP tab.

tab_index.name: Tab Index
tab_index.description: The zero-based index of the RTSP tab to update.

rtsp_transport.name: RTSP Transport
rtsp_transport.description: The RTSP transport protocol to use.

rtsp_decoder.name: RTSP Decoder
rtsp_decoder.description: The decoder to use for the RTSP stream.

audio_enabled.name: Audio Enabled
audio_enabled.description: Whether to enable audio for the RTSP stream.
